scope: Targeted primary-source fact check of two MCQ answer keys; NOT an independent external academic audit and NOT a full distractor review

checked.claim: Kerala onset requires station rainfall plus lower-tropospheric westerlies and supportive outgoing longwave radiation
checked.primary_details: At least 60% of 14 stations with >=2.5 mm on two consecutive days after 10 May, westerlies to 600 hPa, 15-20 kt at 925 hPa, OLR below 200 W/m2 in defined box

checked.claim: First southwest-monsoon withdrawal from northwest India requires five dry days, lower-tropospheric anticyclone and moisture reduction
checked.primary_details: After 1 September: continuous five dry days, anticyclone at 850 hPa and below, substantial moisture reduction
